title: The smaller synthetic execution does not replace the larger theorem
statement: The declared r=64 Hermite layout has M=2,080 hidden coefficients in[.9,1.1], acquired by 2,080 bounded function-value queries under absolute calibration error1e-7. Queries materialize 4,326,400 features / 8,652,800 dense target products; model 16,640 bytes. Fewer than M scalar queries cannot identify arbitrary coefficients in an OPEN domain, not every narrower prediction target. Error tau_c^2<= (M+r)nu^2; deployment noise variance .01 does not earn calibration 1e-7. Actual finite-pattern 8,192 trials with 65 reads give reported MSE .029191553, estimated SE .000474301 versus analytic upper .029789756; unit-pattern finite-ADC run is a different seed/result. Per deployment: 88-byte first ADC/control, 5,200-byte local program, 2-byte final ADC and 2,080dense products remain. Full 2,144-coordinate noisy risk .029595270, fixed 65-design lower bound .893996249. Full digital/direct-target evaluation and adaptive aggregate both use O(M) arithmetic; native target-value service ties the conditional ideal operation only if ACTUALLY available under matched noise/normalization/cost. Exporting all V to perform projection removes acquisition saving. No physical sensor or demonstrated practical total-cost advantage.

requires: Declared r64,p2 feature layout and hidden coefficients in[.9,1.1]. Calibration function-value oracle with absolute error<=1e-7 under bounded synthetic queries,full input/evaluator cost charged.

Deployment uses independent Gaussian U,V,variance-.01 read noise,retained prepared model and actual finite context/pattern/ADC protocol.8192trials are producer reported,not a physical sensor or Capital replay.

Existing substantive internal audits are carried at their exact shared-context scopes; no blind replication or Capital scientific reproof/replay is inferred. Conditional-linear Gaussian value identity needs retained C at final predictor and HARD read/control budgets with every informative side channel charged. Exact exponential-codebook value is not efficient optimization. Known Hermite layout and adequate calibration/model law are substantive. The r=128 theorem and r=64 synthetic acquired run are distinct; fixed-read 2697 is a NECESSARY lower bound, not an attained optimum. Dense actuator generation/application, readout/direction precision and equally informed direct-target/full-input costs remain. No physical apparatus, generic layout learner, computational speedup or demonstrated practical total-cost advantage. Original truthful Jackowski access failure remains unchanged; later coordinator primary-source scope annotation resolves only componentwise-versus-cross-block premise, not historical priority.
costs: Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.

r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.
